## Summary
The transport package defines callback contracts and negotiation state values for RTC transport integrations. It centralizes transport lifecycle, media, data, SDP, ICE, negotiation, stream-state, and unmatched-media callbacks along with default unimplemented behavior.

## Responsibilities
- Define the transport Handler callback interface.
- Provide sentinel errors for missing ICE, offer, and answer handlers.
- Provide an UnimplementedHandler with no-op callbacks and default handler errors.
- Represent negotiation state and convert it to stable string labels.
